```{r}

```

```{r}
diffbind_objs <- list(Background = dbObj_RLEbackground, Reads_in_peak = dbObj_RLERiP, total_counts = dbObj_RPKMnorm, spike_in=dbObj_sacCer3norm, greenlist = dbObj_greenlistnorm)


```


```{r}
pdf(paste("dbObj_counts_summit","pca_plot.pdf"), width = 5, height = 5)

dbObj_counts_summit %>% dba.plotPCA(.,attributes = DBA_TREATMENT, score=DBA_SCORE_READS)
  dev.off()
```


# PCA plots for each normalisation method
```{r}

for (nm in names(diffbind_objs)){
  
  pdf(paste(nm,"pca_plot.pdf"), width = 5, height = 5)

  dba.plotPCA(diffbind_objs[[nm]], attributes = DBA_TREATMENT)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
for (nm in names(diffbind_objs)){
  

  dba.plotMA(diffbind_objs[[nm]], attributes = DBA_TREATMENT)
}

```
